approval: Owner, 2026-11-16: 'Yes, mechanical pass' (match vanilla's upgrade-pair bookkeeping; no design changes).
appliesTo: Every manifest unit line (unitLines + additionalRecruitmentLines) of the core-enabled HoMM3 factions: base, upgrade, alternate upgrade. Vanilla units, neutrals and Conflux fusion units are not touched.

vanillaReference.measured: 42 vanilla faction lines: upgrade and alternate upgrade share gold, rare resources, squadValue and expBonus on 42/42 lines; no upgrade has a stat below its base form; expBonus is squadValue times a per-tier ratio (112/129 line units exact, 124/129 within 1).
vanillaReference.statBudget: sum of 100*ln(upgrade/base) over hp, mean damage, offence, defence, initiative, speed

rules.statFloor: An upgrade or alternate upgrade stat below its base form is raised to the base value. Nothing is lowered to pay for it.
rules.pairParity: The alternate upgrade takes the upgrade's squadValue and whole unitCost (gold and rare resources). The upgrade side is the line's source-derived value (HoMM3 aiValue/price or the 20260625 balance contract); on every line that differed the alternate side was a donor leftover, a side-branch estimate, or left the upgrade/base relation outside vanilla's range, so no line takes the alternate side.
rules.expBonus: expBonus = max(1, round_half_up(squadValue * expBonusPerSquadValueByTier[tier])) for base, upgrade and alternate upgrade. Replaces the value inherited from the vanilla donor row.

lineStatOverrides.reason: Giant line stat budget was 224 (Titan) / 250 (Colossus) against vanilla maxima 200.2 / 213.3, almost all of it the 7 -> 11/12 initiative and speed jump. Base 7 -> 8 puts Titan at 197 without touching Titan. Gold 2000 -> 2400 with Titan 5000 -> 4000 turns the +150% upgrade uplift into +66.7% (vanilla tier 7 maximum +67.9%); 2400/4000 with gemstones 1 -> 2 is the vanilla tier 7 line whose base squadValue (3682) is nearest the Giant's 3718.

Titan gold 5000 -> 4000: see h3_giant. squadValue 7500 -> 6580: the base -> upgrade squadValue uplift was +101.7% against vanilla's +27.8% to +77.3%; 6580 is +77.0% on the Giant's 3718 and matches the vanilla tier 7 line at the same 2400/4000 price (upgrade squadValue 6530). Lowering the Titan (-12%) rather than raising the Giant (+14%) is the smaller move and keeps squadValue in step with the lowered price. The Colossus inherits price and squadValue through pairParity.
Colossus initiative and speed 12 -> 11: with the base at 8 its stat budget is 206, inside vanilla's base-to-alternate maximum 213.3 (it was 250).

Firebird base initiative and speed 15 -> 11. The 20260625 balance contract capped Phoenix at 12 and Sacred Phoenix at 11 and recommended the same cap for the base ('capping speed/initiative near 11-12') but never applied it, which left both upgrades slower than their base. Applying the recorded cap is the smallest change that puts the line back inside vanilla's range; flooring the upgrades to 15 instead would undo the deliberate Phoenix cap (vanilla tier 7 base maxima are initiative 14, speed 8).

notes: Pixie and Genie lines need no entry: the statFloor rule alone brings them inside vanilla's stat-budget range.

This pass runs after homm3_unit_balance_adjustments_20260625.json and wins. That contract's 59 statOverrides values these rules moved (alternate squadValue/cost, floored stats) were rewritten to the resulting values on 2026-11-16, so its own readback validator fails if either contract drifts from the other.
